title: Existence of the normalized common-stage pullback composition representative satisfying its prescribed stage equations
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $\Omega$ with `[Field \Omega] [Algebra \mathbb Q_\ell \Omega] [IsAlgClosure \mathbb Q_\ell \Omega]`, and schemes $X,Y,Z$ on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $h:Z\to X$ be composable morphisms, and let $M$ be an object of the common-stage algebraically closed constructible category on $Y$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. There exists an isomorphism
$$e:(h\circ f)^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}h^*f^*M$$
inside the common-stage category on $Z$ such that, for every finite coefficient stage $L$ containing the stage of $M$, the heterogeneous representative of $e$ is the prescribed `ofHom` map obtained by composing the comparison for $(h\circ f)^*M$ with the rational pullback-composition isomorphism at $L$, then applying the inverse of the rational pullback map for $f$ and the inverse of the rational pullback map for $h$, exactly as in the Lean declaration `pullbackTensorCommonComposition_exists`.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 07A4 and 0941; existence of the normalized common-stage representative

proof.text: Write $E$ for the stage of $M$ and $M_E$ for its rational representative. By [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] the three common-stage pullbacks $(h\circ f)^*M$, $f^*M$ and $h^*f^*M$ are the pairs $(E,L(h\circ f)_E^*M_E)$, $(E,Lf_E^*M_E)$ and $(E,Lh_E^*Lf_E^*M_E)$, so all of them have stage $E$, and for $g\in\{f,h,h\circ f\}$, an object $N$ of stage $E$ and $L\supset E$ the prescribed comparison is $p_{g,N,L}=\tau\circ\theta^g_{E,L,N_E}\circ Lg_L^*(\tau^{-1})$, where $\theta^g_{E,L}:(Lg_E^*N_E)\otimes_EL\xrightarrow{\sim}Lg_L^*(N_E\otimes_EL)$ is the rationalized scalar-extension comparison and $\tau$ denotes the natural transition identifications between the stage-$L$ representative of a pair and the rational scalar extension $-\otimes_EL$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. For every finite field $F$, the rational composition isomorphism $c^F_{h,f}(N):L(h\circ f)_F^*N\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh_F^*Lf_F^*N$ is, by [def-pod-rational-common-pullback-composition], the localization of the integral composition isomorphism $c^{\mathcal O_F}_{h,f}(N)$ of [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition]; it is natural in rational morphisms, because $c^{\mathcal O_F}_{h,f}$ is natural in integral morphisms and the rational pullbacks act on a morphism $u\otimes c$ by $Lg^*(u)\otimes c$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For every $L\supset E$ put $r_L=p_{h\circ f,M,L}\circ c^L_{h,f}(M_L)\circ Lh_L^*(p_{f,M,L}^{-1})\circ p_{h,f^*M,L}^{-1}$ (composition in diagram order, as in the Lean statement), an isomorphism from the stage-$L$ representative of $(h\circ f)^*M$ to that of $h^*f^*M$; it is the map whose class the statement prescribes.

source.place: final paragraph: the operation for $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ by the common-stage coefficient construction (detailed in the DAG node def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, algebraically closed level)

proof.text: Substitute the formula for $p$ into $r_L$. In $Lh_L^*(p_{f,M,L}^{-1})\circ p_{h,f^*M,L}^{-1}$ the factor $Lh_L^*(\tau^{-1})$ coming from $p_{f,M,L}^{-1}$ is followed by the factor $Lh_L^*(\tau)$ coming from $p_{h,f^*M,L}^{-1}$, and they cancel. By naturality of $c^L_{h,f}$ (step 1) applied to the isomorphism $\tau$ on $Y$, the remaining $L(h\circ f)_L^*(\tau^{-1})\circ c^L_{h,f}(M_L)\circ Lh_L^*Lf_L^*(\tau)$ equals $c^L_{h,f}(M_E\otimes_EL)$. Hence, in diagram order, $r_L=\tau\circ\theta^{h\circ f}_{E,L,M_E}\circ c^L_{h,f}(M_E\otimes_EL)\circ Lh_L^*(\theta^f_{E,L,M_E})^{-1}\circ(\theta^h_{E,L,Lf_E^*M_E})^{-1}\circ\tau^{-1}$. Clause 1 of [lem-pod-pullback-identities-scalar-extension], with $k=f$, $h=h$ and $K$ the integral object underlying $M_E$, gives the integral identity $Lh_L^*(\alpha^f_K)\circ\alpha^h_{Lf_E^*K}\circ T_Z(c^{\mathcal O_E}_{h,f}(K))=c^{\mathcal O_L}_{h,f}(T_YK)\circ\alpha^{h\circ f}_K$ of isomorphisms $T_Z(L(h\circ f)_E^*K)\to Lh_L^*Lf_L^*(T_YK)$. Apply the localization functor: the rational $\theta^g_{E,L}$ is the localization of the integral comparison $\alpha^g$ of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension] [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the rational $c^E_{h,f}$ and $c^L_{h,f}$ are the localizations of the integral composition isomorphisms [def-pod-rational-common-pullback-composition], and the rational scalar extension is the localization of the integral one [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. So $c^L_{h,f}(M_E\otimes_EL)\circ\theta^{h\circ f}_{E,L,M_E}=Lh_L^*(\theta^f_{E,L,M_E})\circ\theta^h_{E,L,Lf_E^*M_E}\circ(c^E_{h,f}(M_E)\otimes_EL)$, and substituting gives $r_L=\tau\circ(c^E_{h,f}(M_E)\otimes_EL)\circ\tau^{-1}$. By naturality of $\tau$, $r_L$ is the image of $r_E$ under the transition from stage $E$ to stage $L$ (the case $L=E$ of the same formula identifies $r_E$ with $c^E_{h,f}(M_E)$ conjugated by $\tau$ at $L=E$). This uses the specified compositors and comparisons only, never the tower identity of the comparisons alone.

source.place: final paragraph: common-stage construction; independence of the chosen common extension

proof.text: Morphisms of the common-stage category are classes in the directed colimit over common finite fields, a representative over $L$ and its transition to $L'\supset L$ having the same class, and composites are computed over one common field [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $e$ have forward arrow the class of $r_E$ and inverse arrow the class of $r_E^{-1}$; both composites are classes of identities computed at stage $E$, so $e$ is an isomorphism between $(h\circ f)^*M$ and $h^*f^*M$, which are the objects of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] from step 1. By step 2, for every $L\supset E$ the class of $r_L$ (the `ofHom` map at $L$ for any proof $h_M$ of the stage containment) equals the class of $r_E$, i.e. $e.\mathrm{hom}$; this is the displayed `HEq` condition, both sides having the same source and target.

lean.statement: theorem pullbackTensorCommonComposition_exists {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X) [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)] (M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y) : ∃ e : ((@commonStageDerivedPullback l _ Ω _ _ _ Z Y (h ≫ f) hZ hY)).obj M ≅ ((@commonStageDerivedPullback l _ Ω _ _ _ Z X h hZ hX)).obj (((@commonStageDerivedPullback l _ Ω _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj M), ∀ (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω) (hM : M.stage ≤ L), HEq e.hom (ofHom (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω (h ≫ f) M) (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω h (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f M)) L hM hM ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω (h ≫ f) M L hM).hom ≫ ((@pullbackTensorRationalComposition l _ (_root_.WeilConjectures.AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) _ _ _ X Y Z f h hX hY hZ) (M.toStage hM)).hom ≫ ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ (_root_.WeilConjectures.AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) _ _ _ Z X h hZ hX)).map (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f M L hM).inv ≫ (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω h (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f M) L hM).inv))
